# OMP Strata

> Profile, lifecycle tool and acceptance evidence for running the stock Oh My Pi (OMP) coding agent against
> a stock, local Strata inference server on one Windows 11 + RTX host. It forks neither project and adds no
> proxy: every download is pinned by URL, size and SHA-256; stock `setup.py` runs unmodified from verified
> local inputs; Strata binds to loopback behind an API key; stock OMP runs in an isolated profile with every
> model role on the local server and no cloud fallback. Python standard library only. Qualified and current (2026-11-27):
> stock Strata v0.2.22 (engine 0.1.69) + stock OMP 19.2.1 on the RTX PRO 6000 (rollback: the v0.2.16 four-slot DFlash2
> profile), the RTX 5090 262K Coder IQ1_M default (rollback: the v0.2.13 262K profile) and 131K Coder IQ1_M alternative
> (rollback: the v0.2.16 131K profile), and the Mac Studio route (rollback: the v0.2.16 route). The RTX 4090 + RTX 3090
> pair stays on stock Strata v0.2.16 with stock OMP 19.0.0 (qualified 2026-11-19): the owner kept v0.2.16 after the
> v0.2.22 pair draft missed its A/B. The RTX 5090 full-model IQ3_S 131K low-RAM resident v0.2.13 alternate keeps its
> role. In three paired cold starts per lane (`A1 B1 B2 A2 A3 B3`, reporting `B / A` geometric means with `A` the lane's
> current profile), the owner's rule makes a profile current only if every real-host gate passes and no paired metric
> is more than 5% worse; every v0.2.22 lane that ran an A/B missed that bar, and each decision below is the owner's,
> quoted verbatim. An override waives only the A/B miss; the profile still has to pass every real-host gate. Restart
> recall (G15) passed on every lane.
> On the RTX 4090 + RTX 3090 pair in `rtx3090-win-a`
> (`win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-262k-df2conf05-disp4090-roles-split24-trimweights-pledirect-env86gt-strata0.2.16-omp19.0.0`;
> [ledger](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-262k-df2conf05-disp4090-roles-split24-trimweights-pledirect-env86gt-strata0.2.16-omp19.0.0/qualification.json)),
> the v0.2.13 `df2conf05` choices run on stock v0.2.16: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next IQ3_S at the trained 262,144-token context,
> stock roles `--gpu-roles 0=main,1=helper` putting the RTX 4090 as Main staged last, manual layer split 24
> `--layer-split 24`, stage dense-weight trim `--trim-stage-weights` (`strata.trim_stage_weights: true`), stock DFlash2
> drafting alone via `strata.drafting: "dflash2"` (packed offline during `install` by stock `dflash2_pack.py` from pinned
> `incoai/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-DFlash2` files) and `strata.drafting_args` pinning `{"--draft-conf": "0.5"}` (`df2conf05`,
> stock's slot-step value for the pair's per-card slots, which stock cannot compute on a split, written to stock
> `user_args` with stock `write_config`), dropping `--pipeline-windows 2`, no batch slots, display on the RTX 4090,
> `strata.ple_io: "direct"` pinning stock `--ple-io direct` to keep the 26.8 GiB per-layer embedding (PLE) table on direct
> SSD reads, the engine's 8,192 MiB automatic conversation cache, `strata.engine_env` `env86gt` (the engine 0.1.62 `sm_86`
> table's 8 variables, stock `gdn_stack` and two-pass QSA block selection `STRATA_SELECT_TWO_PASS=1`) and
> `"undeclared_tool_calls": "call"` (the `df2conf05` and `env86gt` ids drop `-parking` only to stay within the
> 120-character profile-id limit, with the same `strata.stock_tips`). Its A/B against v0.2.13 missed 30 of 96 checks:
> cold prompts read slower at every depth (prompt tokens/s 8K 0.939, 32K 0.896, 100K 0.885, 200K 0.876; TTFT 1.06-1.14)
> and the 32K single request read 0.928, while decode was mostly better (TPOT p50 0.917 / 0.944, cold decode
> 0.994-1.065, per-request 1.090 / 1.056) and repeated 32K prompt TTFT read 0.148. The owner decided `"Override the miss
> and qualify it."` Its first start refused with `"stock drafting: exactly one --draft required in the started engine
> argv"` because the started-argv parser consumed the space after the valueless `--trim-stage-weights` (fixed at
> `e730509`). Every gate then passed: G16 43.2 s, G20 43.1 s, G21 43.4 s, G15 recall 49.5 s (idle kill) and 47.2 s
> (mid-generation kill), G17 near-limit task 65.0 s, G10 65.96 GiB available RAM and 28.29 GiB Windows commit headroom of
> a 135.69 GiB limit, 45 parks in G19, G24 16/18 (pilot 5/6, batch wall 774 s), and five more owner-approved G15 runs,
> an attempt to reproduce the restart fault behind Niko1221/Strata#6316, all passed. It rolls back to the v0.2.13 `df2conf05` profile
> `win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-262k-df2conf05-disp4090-roles-split24-trimweights-pledirect-env86gt-strata0.2.13-omp18.18.3`,

> Stock v0.2.22 (tag object `a6f14f067fc4a2be660284039b33234937cbf555` peeling to
> `b28ca95e3e6847f2d5e317994f253b66716deeaa`, published 2026-11-25T18:52:49Z; app 0.2.22, Control and engines 0.1.69)
> ships engine 0.1.69 (build `a5bfe0369bfb+cuda13.0`, `strata-engine-0.1.69-windows-x86_64-cuda-cuda13.tar.gz`,
> 494,711,524 bytes) as its Windows CUDA 13 component; layout and setup invocation are unchanged since v0.2.16, and every
> lane's stock-generated config is unchanged. Stock's server now sizes a RAM conversation cache when the config sets
> none; no lane pins `--conversation-cache-mib`, so the PRO gets 48,640 MiB and the pair 25,344 MiB, while on the RTX
> 5090 the stock size stays under 8,192 MiB and the engine keeps its own default (4,352 MiB at 262K, 3,584 MiB at 131K).
> The server also sets `STRATA_ROUTE_TAIL_SKIP=0` when the config env does not name it and `OMP_NUM_THREADS` to the pool
> workers on the PRO; the start checks admit exactly these stock values. Engine 0.1.69 keeps the stage order;
> for the pair's v0.2.22 draft, the `sm_86` table is stock's 18 variables (the id keeps `env86gt`); two-card splits arm a CPU prefill share by default,
> and fused prompt kernels start at 3,072-token chunks (1,024 before). Three engine deaths within 600 s on one server
> process now stop restarts with HTTP 503; the gate sequences stay below that, and G15 reruns use a fresh server. New
> key-checked routes `/v1/models/{id}` and `/models/{id}` are probed by G13 (no key or wrong key 401, correct key 200).
> The DFlash2 drafter, window, confidence, packs, vocabulary and start lines are unchanged. Stock OMP 19.2.1
> (`b55cd1bb664d8ab46ddc77f2a34eb47555dbf1ac`, published 2026-11-25T17:10:03Z) keeps the chat wire, rendered keys and
> defaults; HTTP 500 is no longer replayed after transport retries (6 requests, not 12); its fixed context grew to
> 6,793 tokens, so G13 and G18 force compaction at 11,000 tokens and G17 allows 7,900 tokens of overhead. Because the
> launcher sets `providers.maxInFlightRequests`, every OMP run that reaches Strata starts a per-user provider-slot worker
> that exits about 3 s after its last client (3.0-3.1 s measured on Windows); clients sharing an OMP home join a live
> worker, and the gates allow exactly that worker and nothing else.
> v0.2.16 shipped its engine (0.1.62, build `1d295787b365+cuda13.0`,
> `strata-engine-0.1.62-windows-x86_64-cuda-cuda13.tar.gz`, 487,452,901 bytes) as a separately versioned CUDA 13
> component tarball staged into stock's `terminal/engine` folder, reusing
> `locks/strata-python-cp313-win_amd64-strata0.2.11.txt` (26 hash-locked wheels). Stock v0.2.16 moved into
> `engine/ app/ terminal/ docs/ tools/`; `install` materializes the terminal layout for v0.2.16 and later profiles and
> keeps v0.2.13 and older rollback roots flat. Setup's own package install needs its offline stamp, so setup now runs
> without `STRATA_NO_ACQUIRE` while pip stays offline through `PIP_NO_INDEX`; setup no longer uses llama.cpp, so
> v0.2.16 and v0.2.22 profiles pin no llama.cpp archive. Engine 0.1.62 runs prompt experts on Strata's own fused int8
> kernels on every NVIDIA card class these lanes use (llama.cpp's MMQ kernels are gone from the Windows archive), and
> stock's `sm_86` table dropped `STRATA_ADAPT_NOWAIT`; GDN tensor-core numerics are not bit-exact upstream, and engine
> env pins are reviewed per engine release in `ENGINE_ENV_REVIEWED_ENGINES`, which includes 0.1.62. Stock exposes `undeclared_tool_calls` on
> neither `/config` nor `/props`, so `install` proves it through the generated config file's identity. With OMP 19.0.0
> the launcher turns off `composer.predictions`, `launch.enabled` and `spelling.autocomplete`, fixes
> `PI_AI_CODEX_CLIENT_VERSION` and disables the `ssh-json` and `ssh-config` providers; on OMP 19.0.0, G13 and G18 used a
> 10,000-token compaction threshold because OMP 19 refuses a threshold compaction when its fixed context (system prompt
> and tool schemas, measured 5,940 tokens) exceeds 80% of the threshold.

> while both cards are installed: they name GPU 0, now the RTX 4090. Earlier qualified history: on the RTX PRO 6000, stock Strata v0.1.41 + stock OMP
> 18.8.6 with the same choices at 262,144 tokens, then at 131,072 tokens, then the same choices on v0.1.40.3 + OMP
> 18.8.4, then OMP 18.8.3, then v0.1.40.2 + 18.8.0 without them; on the RTX 5090, v0.1.41 + OMP 18.8.6, then
> v0.1.40.3 + OMP 18.8.4, then stock Strata v0.1.34 + stock OMP 18.4.10, which also stays qualified on the
> single-card RTX 3090 and RTX 4090. Community project; not affiliated with or endorsed by the
> Oh My Pi maintainers, the Strata maintainer, Qwen or NVIDIA.

## Install

- From a checkout, with the current candidate profile: `validate` → `fetch` → `install` → `keygen` →
  `start` → `launch-omp` → `stop` (`py -3 scripts\omp_strata.py <command> --profile <profile> --root <root>`).
- One integration root per candidate; nothing is written to the user's normal OMP configuration or to
  `%APPDATA%\Strata`.

## Boundaries

- Supported: the qualified profiles under `profiles/` (Windows 11, a single NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000, RTX 5090, RTX 3090
  or RTX 4090, or the RTX 4090 + RTX 3090 layer-split pair; every other profile is a draft or a rollback installation),
  text only, single user, loopback only.
- Remote use: the Mac Studio's current qualified route,
  `client-rtxpro6000-262k-df2-pledirect-kvvram-envpg-strata0.2.22-omp19.2.1`, runs stock OMP 19.2.1 through an
  SSH local forward to `win11-rtxpro6000-iq3s-262k-slots4-df2-pledirect-kvvram-envpg-parking-strata0.2.22-omp19.2.1`,
  the PRO's current v0.2.22 262K `df2` DFlash2 profile (G23 pass on 2026-11-27, 15:54-15:56Z: missing key refused before
  launch, wrong key HTTP 401, health RTT 4.9-6.1 ms and tunnel TTFT 0.141 s; a tunnel drop failed the turn in flight
  with the transcript preserved, server and client restart recall passed, resume took 0.59 s (tunnel) / 0.65 s
  (client) / 1.09 s (server), the provider-slot worker exited 3.036 s after the client, and the `launch-omp` smoke
  returned rc 0). Its qualified rollback, `client-rtxpro6000-262k-df2-pledirect-kvvram-envpg-strata0.2.16-omp19.0.0`,
  reaches the PRO's v0.2.16 262K `df2` DFlash2 rollback (G23 pass on 2026-11-19, published at `99ef483`: missing key
  refused before launch, wrong key HTTP 401, health RTT 4.8-5.2 ms and tunnel TTFT 0.179 s, and a one-turn
  `launch-omp` smoke answered `ROUTE OK`). The v0.2.16 tuned-pack route
  `client-rtxpro6000-262k-df2tuned-pledirect-kvvram-envpg-strata0.2.16-omp19.0.0` never ran G23 because its server
  profile did not qualify. The 0.2.13 `df2` (`client-rtxpro6000-262k-df2-pledirect-kvvram-envpg-strata0.2.13-omp18.18.3`,
  published at `2af52b8`, stream TTFT 0.217 s), 0.2.13 `df2tuned`
  (`client-rtxpro6000-262k-df2tuned-pledirect-kvvram-envpg-strata0.2.13-omp18.18.3`, published at `8ab88b0`, stream
  TTFT 0.181 s), 0.2.12 `df2` (`client-rtxpro6000-262k-df2-pledirect-kvvram-envpg-strata0.2.12-omp18.18.0`), 0.2.12
  `df2tuned`, 0.2.11 `df2`, 0.2.11 `batchmtp`, 0.2.10 `kvvram-envpg`,
  0.2.9 `kvvram-envpg`, 0.2.9 batch-MTP base, 0.2.8 batch-MTP, 0.2.8 `slots4-parking`, 0.2.7, 0.2.3, 0.2.1, 0.1.44.1,
  0.1.43.1, 0.1.43 and 0.1.42 262K routes and `client-rtxpro6000-strata0.1.41-omp18.8.6` 131K route stay earlier history.
- Not supported: images, remote clients other than the qualified current and rollback Mac-to-RTX PRO 6000 routes, other
  operating systems, durable engine state across restarts, multiple tenants. Comparisons with other runtimes are
  separate, comparison-only tools.
- Security: loopback only, API key required on every model, control and metrics route, key in a user-only
  file, ambient provider credentials scrubbed from OMP's environment, no telemetry. Not a sandbox, a
  multi-tenant service or an egress firewall.
